summary:
**Status: complete.** Read-only baseline done on branch `main` (`3e5c009`). No commits, moves, installs, or edits made. Tree is clean except untracked `.hoocode/` agent scratch.

## Gap 1 — `uv.lock` missing (bigger than just a missing file)

**Evidence**
- `docs/DESIGN.md:111` (§4.1): "`cyv setup` builds the daemon venv with `uv` from a committed, macOS-arm64-tested **`uv.lock`**." Layout §7 (`docs/DESIGN.md:230`) also lists `uv.lock`. Root listing + `ls uv.lock` → **No such file**.
- Deeper gap: `src/cyv/setup.py` `plan()` has **no lock support at all** — it runs `uv pip install … -c daemon-constraints.txt '<project>[daemon]'` then `-r <applio>/requirements-engine.txt` plus a hash-pinned spaCy wheel (`setup.py:274-330`, `daemon-constraints.txt:1-6`, `daemon-spacy.txt:1`). Constraints pin only `preshed==3.0.9` + `torch>=2.6`; everything else floats.
- `tests/test_setup.py:16-22` dry-run test asserts needles `"venv --python 3.12"`, `"[daemon]"`, `"fetch --depth 1"`, `"requirements-engine.txt"` — it will need updating when `plan()` changes.

**Close-out recipe (maintainer, on a macOS arm64 Mac — this box is arm64/macOS 27.2)**
1. `brew install uv` (verified absent here: `uv: command not found`).
2. **Decide lock scope first.** Applio installs from a git-fetched `requirements-engine.txt`, not PyPI, so plain `uv lock` on this project covers only `.[daemon]`+dev. Either (a) `uv pip compile` the daemon set (`-c src/cyv/daemon-constraints.txt`, Python 3.12, `aarch64-apple-darwin` target) and commit the pinned file, or (b) restructure daemon deps into a lockable uv project and `uv lock` that — option (b) matches DESIGN's "`uv.lock`" wording.
3. Rewire `plan()` to consume the lock (`uv sync --locked` or `uv pip install --require-hashes -r <lock>`), update the dry-run needles in `test_setup.py`, and sync `CONTRIBUTING.md` + DESIGN §4.1/§11 wording to what setup actually does.
4. Record the clean-Mac run as `docs/benchmarks/B0-clean-install.md` (versions, timing) — the lock *is* part of B0 evidence.

**Risks:** resolve for the arm64/MPS torch wheels explicitly; keep installing from PyPI (never vendor a wheelhouse — GPL espeak-ng redistribution issue, `docs/licenses.md`); keep the Applio git-fetch step outside the lock and documented; regenerating requires network + full resolve.

## Gap 2 — CI parked at `docs/ci/`

**Evidence**
- `.github/` has `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` (`benchmark_result.yml`, `bug_report.yml`, `config.yml`, `feature_request.yml`) + `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`; `ls .github/workflows` → **No such file**.
- `docs/ci/ci.yml`: lint job (ubuntu, `checkout@v4`, `setup-uv@v6`, ruff check + format check + three security greps) and test job (matrix `macos-14`/`ubuntu-latest`, py3.12, `.[dev]`, torch, ffmpeg, pytest). `docs/ci/README.md` gives the exact activation command.

**Staleness vs `pyproject.toml`: essentially fresh.** Dev extras, `requires-python >=3.11` vs CI's 3.12, ruff config, and `torch>=2.6` floor all line up. Installing only `.[dev]`+torch (not `.[daemon]`) is intentional — tests `importorskip` torch/kokoro/audioseal/soxr/faiss (`tests/test_components.py:274-275`, `tests/test_integration.py:21`) and E2E is gated on `CYV_E2E=1`, which CI doesn't set. One nit: DESIGN §7 (`docs/DESIGN.md:231`) promises "workflows/ (ruff, pytest macos-14, notebook lint)" but the parked file has **no notebook-lint job** — notebook checks live inside pytest (`tests/test_notebook.py:81-86` pin-match test). Fix the DESIGN wording or add the job at activation.

**Close-out:** maintainer with GitHub `workflow` scope runs `git mv docs/ci/ci.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml && git commit -m "ci: activate workflow" && git push`, re-confirms action versions are current, and watches the first matrix run green.

## Gap 3 — `docs/licenses.md` coverage

- **espeak-ng GPL note: present.** Runtime-only rationale section exists ("Why espeak-ng is a runtime dependency only") — check passes.
- **Direct daemon dep with no row: `soxr>=0.5`** (`pyproject.toml:19`; added per DESIGN §11) — violates the CONTRIBUTING ground rule (new dep → row in same PR). **This is the one real licenses gap.**
- Also row-less despite being `cyv setup`-installed per DESIGN §11: `preshed`, `spaCy`, `en_core_web_sm` model. Recommend a "setup-installed transitives" subsection at minimum (faiss/transformers/torchaevia Applio need a scoping decision).
- Pre-existing `verify` rows (misaki, espeakng-loader, torch, numpy, soundfile, HuBERT/ContentVec, RMVPE, Kokoro weights, dev/build tools) are acknowledged in-file — fine as a pre-release checklist.
- **Engine/TTS benchmark rule: currently satisfied** — `docs/benchmarks/` has `B4-watermark.md`, `B5-weights-only.md`, `B6-synthid.md`, `linux-cpu-e2e.md`, and the PR template enforces it. B0–B3 (macOS) are still open — expected, they need a Mac setup run.

**Close-out:** add `soxr` (+ preshed/spaCy/en_core_web_sm) rows with license + status; docs-only, no code change.

## Gap 4 — baseline lint / test collect: not runnable here

- `python3 -m ruff --version` → `No module named ruff`; `python3 -m pytest --version` → `No module named pytest` (system python3 is Homebrew 3.14; repo has no `.venv`). **Said so, did not install**, per constraints — so the "218 tests pass" claim in DESIGN §11 is unverified in this environment.
- **Close-out commands (from `CONTRIBUTING.md`):** `uv venv .venv --python 3.12 && uv pip install -e '.[dev]'` (+ torch: `--index-url …/cpu` on Linux, default wheel on Mac), then `.venv/bin/ruff check .`, `.venv/bin/ruff format --check .`, `.venv/bin/python -m pytest --collect-only -q` for the baseline, then full `pytest`.

## Deliberately did not run (and why)
`uv`/pip installs, `uv lock`/`uv pip compile` (uv absent + needs network resolve), `git mv` activation, `CYV_E2E=1` tests, model downloads, any tree writes — all forbidden by the read-only/no-install constraints.
